from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitations(BaseModel):
    """Information extractable from one paper about its references to other provided papers."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that this paper cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitations]
